text:
mike: Heads-up - noticed 3 customers got charged after reconnect->fallback today. Suspect late-ack + prefix ownership flip + truncation. Logs show provisional charge then confirm charge without dedupe. /cc @sam @irene :eyes:

mike: log excerpt:
```json
{"route_id":"r-42","session_id":"s-7","ack_offset":1200,"event":"ACK","status":"late","token_count_provisional":120}
```

irene: repro steps? client reconnect? toolcall? :thinking_face:

sam: client reconnect + router fallback to secondary pool. Router reassigns prefix owner before we've reconciled pending provisional ledger. When ACK arrives it's applied against new owner path and ledger doesn't dedupe because session_id changed.

alex: So root cause = session_id reuse/regen on reconnect. Could we include a durable session token that's stable across connection swaps? We already have `session_token` vs `ephemeral_ws_id` distinction in the protocol.

nate: Quick query showing spike:
```
sum by(route_id) (increase(provisional_tokens{env="prod"}[5m]))
```

nate: provisional_tokens + confirmed_tokens diverging for r-42 between 12:01-12:05.

billing-bot: Alert: provisional->confirmed delta > 50 for route r-42. Ticket #INC-4521 created.

irene: UX idea for Console: surface provisional vs confirmed tokens per route + per-customer with an "at-risk" tag and link to traces. PMs like that.

sam: For hotfix, suggestion: when fallback happens, router should forward original session_id in handoff header `X-Origin-Session`, and ledger dedupe should check either session_id OR origin_session.

mike: patch in mind: ledger: treat token event dedupe key = (customer_id, request_prefix_hash, token_sequence_id) rather than session_id alone. That would avoid double-charge on session swap.

alex: That may have perf impact on ledger index size. Alternative: short TTL mapping from ephemeral_session -> origin_session stored in redis for 60s.

sam: We should A/B test approach. Proposal: rollout redis-ttl mapping to 1% traffic for 24h. Add metric `late_ack_dedupe_hits`.

irene: Chart proposal for Console: new "Provisional risk" card. Fields: route, customer, provisional_tokens, confirmed_tokens, late_ack_rate. Add "Reconcile" action to re-run ledger diff.

mike: Who owns infra change? @sam will do router header change + feature flag. @alex will add redis mapping. @nate will add dashboard widgets. @irene will mock UX. Target 1% rollout by EOD Thurs.

sam: ack, will open PR and link here.

mike: thx :thumbsup:
